interface Named { name?: string }
class Strict implements Named { name: string | number = 1; }
class Optional implements Named { name?: number; }
interface Labeled { label: string }
class MaybeLabeled implements Labeled { label?: string; }
class ParameterLabeled implements Labeled { constructor(public label: number) {} }
interface Both { name?: string; size: number }
class Incomplete implements Both { name: string | undefined = ""; }
